CAST artwork decision brief · 17 July 2026

Lock the Set.
Resolve the Four.

Fifteen covers are now treated as production winners. The remaining work is a narrow retry round for channel, ops, pull-feed, and think.

Operating assumption: do not reopen the style, robot language, moodboard, or existing winners. Solve only the four failed metaphors.
15Locked covers
4Unresolved skills
8New prompts
2%Maximum gold area

The recovered trio.

The old MJ LAB nodes had been deleted from Figma, so the original Midjourney jobs were recovered and re-judged against the newer, more restrained winners.

The rest of the lock.

These 12 selections from the July 10 batch remain unchanged. Together with the recovered trio, they establish the production bar.

Functional gold,
not golden motion.

Each retry permits one tiny antique-gold latch, tag, pin, clip, coupling, or rivet—less than two percent of the image. The prompts explicitly ban gold ribbon, trail, beam, circle, arc, and large gold swash.

The retry brief.

Each unresolved skill gets two distinct physical metaphors. Direction A is the recommended first run; Direction B is a deliberate fallback, not a minor variation.

Why it missed

The current image reads as radio or sound transmission, not loading a package persona into the conversation.
